title: Looks Right, Works Right: A Project-Level Benchmark for Multi-Screen Mobile App Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.28645v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models can convert visual designs directly into executable code, but real mobile products require multiple screenshots to become a buildable codebase with shared components and working navigation. This project-level setting exposes three limits of existing design-to-code benchmarks: they focus on single-page generation rather than complete codebases, cannot evaluate cross-page navigation, and do not measure project-wide maintainability. We introduce MobileForge, the first benchmark for project-level multi-screen mobile app generation, comprising real mobile apps, human-reviewed screens, structured page-relationship annotations, and navigation test specifications. MobileForge supports five-axis evaluation of build, navigation, visual fidelity, code maintainability, and efficiency. translated_title: 外观正确，运行正确：多屏移动应用生成的项目级基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.28645v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：最近的多模态大语言模型可以将视觉设计直接转换为可执行代码，但真实的移动产品需要多个截图才能成为具有共享组件和可工作导航的可构建代码库。这种项目级设置暴露了现有设计到代码基准的三个限制：它们专注于单页生成而非完整代码库，无法评估跨页面导航，并且不衡量项目范围的可维护性。我们引入了MobileForge，这是第一个用于项目级多屏移动应用生成的基准，包含真实移动应用、人工审查的屏幕、结构化的页面关系注释和导航测试规范。MobileForge支持构建、导航、视觉保真度、代码可维护性和效率的五轴评估。我们还提出了状态隔离导航测试，以避免导航评估中的级联失败，以及锚点（anchor）机制。
tldr: 本文提出了MobileForge，这是首个项目级多屏移动应用生成基准，通过五轴评估和状态隔离导航测试，解决了现有基准无法处理完整代码库、跨页导航和可维护性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MobileForge, the first project-level benchmark for multi-screen mobile app generation, addressing limitations of existing benchmarks by enabling five-axis evaluation and state-isolated navigation testing for complete codebases and cross-page navigation.
